value.rationale: The mod-three one-cosystole is a natural sparsity invariant of a nontrivial cohomology class and a finite topological-code parameter. For this vertex-minimal torsion lens-space triangulation, the exact distance 28, the 18 minimizing supports, and their four S_3 orbits are not determined by the abstract homology group, face vector, or shortest-cycle census. The result is a self-contained exact benchmark rather than a renaming or routine consequence of known homology.
